result.reason: The edit appropriately extends the licence to affiliates and contractors and removes the express revocability and transfer restrictions. However, it does not establish that a paid-up licence is perpetual and irrevocable, and “terminable only in accordance with Section 4” does not itself limit termination to an uncured material breach. Likewise, transferability depends on unknown Section 14(h), so transfer to an M&A successor is not assured by the rendered language. The continuing limitation to Customer’s websites may also undercut meaningful affiliate use. The changes are targeted and generally preserve the original commercial purpose, but the operative language does not reach the preferred or fallback position on the information provided.
